de_circularized_eval.note: Panel-masked recovery uses disease-local negative voc_effects plus pathway_bias — not re-injected VOC priors. Global ketone/gut maps left positive for T2D/SIBO. Near-floor VOCs (e.g. MDD ethanol) are excluded from mechanism_backed accuracy.

negative_voc_effects_convention.policy: Prefer disease-local pathways with negative coefs over inverting shared ketone/gut maps
